observations: Photo 0 shows a grey Xbox console with a white controller placed on top. The console has 'AW' and 'CALL OF DUTY' branding, along with 'SENTINEL TANK FORCE' and 'INTERNATIONAL GLOBAL DEFENSE' text. The controller has 'Nexon' branding on the faceplate.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the same console and controller, with the 'AW' and 'CALL OF DUTY' branding clearly visible. The controller has 'Nexon' branding on the faceplate.
Photo 2 shows a close-up of the controller, focusing on the buttons and joysticks. The controller appears to be a standard Xbox controller with no visible damage or wear.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a screen. No games are visible on the console or in the photos.
The seller claims 1TB storage, one wired controller, and games installed. None of these are visible in the photos.

identity.kind: Xbox console with Call of Duty edition controller

claims.claim: Call of duty edition xbox comes with 1tb storage
claims.evidence: No photo shows the console's storage capacity or any internal components. The 'AW' and 'CALL OF DUTY' branding suggests a special edition, but storage is not visible.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 show a white controller with 'Nexon' branding, which is a wired controller.
No games are visible on the console or in the photos. The console is not shown powered on or connected to a screen.

risks.risk: Console may not have 1TB storage as claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the console's system settings screen showing storage capacity, or a photo of the console's internal components.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-capacity console (e.g., 500GB) or as not having the claimed storage.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be pirated
risks.proof: Photo of the console's library screen showing installed games, or a screenshot of the games list.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not having games installed, or as having pirated games.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, or with a significant discount for potential hardware failure.

proof_requests: Photo of the console's system settings screen showing storage capacity.
Photo of the console's library screen showing installed games.
Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Photo of the console's internal components or serial number if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
